confidence_notes: Current Palm Springs aggregates give food anchors of about $21–30 for an inexpensive meal, $75–88 for a midrange meal for two, $5.47–5.50 for cappuccino, and $5 for draft beer. Cocktail and wine-glass estimates use local bar pricing relative to beer (about 3x and 2.5x). Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates with substantial seasonal uncertainty and limited hostel comparables.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Palm Springs-specific cost-of-living aggregates; lodging reflects a resort-oriented California desert city with seasonal visitor demand.
